python - <<'PYS'
import json,copy
p='babylm/configs/jobs_base_seeds_base_S_wd0p4_lr0p5_r1_ve0_tied.json'
d=json.load(open(p))
s1=[x for x in d['jobs'] if x['name'].endswith('_s1')][0]
for k in (3,4):
    x=copy.deepcopy(s1); n=s1['name'][:-1]+str(k); x['name']=n; a=x['args']
    a[a.index('--seed')+1]=str(k) if isinstance(a[a.index('--seed')+1],str) else k; a[a.index('--tag')+1]=n
    d['jobs'].append(x)
json.dump(d,open(p,'w'),indent=1)
PYS
cp babylm/configs/jobs_base_seeds_base_S_wd0p4_lr0p5_r1_ve0_tied.json _logs/; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_twin_ref-0049.py babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py; python - <<'PYC'
import json
j=[x for x in json.load(open('babylm/configs/jobs_base_s1.json'))['jobs'] if x['name']=='base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5'][0]
j['name']='base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_final'; a=j['args']; a[a.index('--tag')+1]='base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_final'
json.dump({'jobs':[j]},open('babylm/configs/jobs_ctrl_final.json','w'),indent=1)
PYC
cp babylm/configs/jobs_ctrl_final.json _logs/; for n in $CELLS; do cfg=${CFG:-babylm/configs/jobs_base_r1_S.json}; case $n in *_r2_*) cfg=babylm/configs/jobs_base_r2_S.json;; esac; [ $n = base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_final ] && cfg=babylm/configs/jobs_ctrl_final.json; python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs $cfg --only $n --device cuda || echo "[cells] train $n failed"; [ -f babylm/runs/$n/result.json ] && { bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/$n /opt/babylm || echo "[cells] score $n failed"; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py babylm/runs/$n/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out babylm/runs/$n/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/$n/score/dev_bpw_twin.log 2>&1 || echo "[twin] $n failed"; python -m babylm.analysis.perword babylm/runs/$n --epochs_only || echo "[cells] perword $n failed"; }; done; if [ "${BENCH:-0}" = 1 ]; then nvidia-cuda-mps-control -d && echo '[pack] MPS on'; python - <<'PYB' > _logs/pack_cmds.txt
import json,shlex
j=[x for x in json.load(open('babylm/configs/jobs_base_r1_S.json'))['jobs'] if x['name'].endswith('_r1_ve0_tied')][0]
a=[str(x) for x in j['args']]
i=a.index('--out') if '--out' in a else None
a=[x for k,x in enumerate(a) if i is None or k not in (i,i+1)]
a=[x for x in a if x not in ('--save',)]
print(' '.join(shlex.quote(x) for x in a))
PYB
for k in 1 2 3; do for i in $(seq 1 $k); do timeout 300 python -m babylm.harness.train $(cat _logs/pack_cmds.txt) --device cuda --out /tmp/pack_${k}_$i > _logs/pack_${k}_$i.log 2>&1 & done; wait; python - $k <<'PYS'
import re,sys,statistics as s
k=int(sys.argv[1]); tot=0
for i in range(1,k+1):
    v=[float(x.replace(',','')) for x in re.findall(r'([0-9,]+) tok/s',open(f'_logs/pack_{k}_{i}.log').read())][-5:]
    m=s.median(v) if v else 0; tot+=m; print(f'[pack] k={k} copy={i} tok/s={m:,.0f} n={len(v)}')
print(f'[pack] k={k} aggregate tok/s={tot:,.0f}')
PYS
done; echo quit | nvidia-cuda-mps-control; rm -rf /tmp/pack_*;  fi
